sentences.text:
The present appeal is filed under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to set aside the judgment dated 04.01.2024 passed by the court of Sh. Deepak Dabas, ADJ-01, North District,
Rohini Courts, Delhi in LAC bearing no. 276/2021 titled as Satish Kumar V Union of India & Anr.,
seeking further enhancement in compensation amount and modification to the extent thereof in the impugned judgment arising out of the award bearing no. 12/2005-06/DC/(NW) pertaining to village Barwala, Delhi.

entities.text:

Rohini Courts, Delhi

sentences.text: 7. Issue notice.
8. Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no. 1/Union of India, accepts notice.
Mr. Shobhna Takiar, Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no. 2/DDA, accepts notice.

9. The counsel for the appellant stated that the connected appeal bearing LA APP. no. 138/2018 titled as Chander Bhan (Deceased) Through LRs V Union of India & Anr. pertaining to the same village and award has already been admitted and the same is ordered to be listed in the category of Regular Matters.
10.
The present appeal is also admitted for hearing and be listed in the category of Regular Matters in due course along with other connected appeals.
DR. SUDHIR KUMAR JAIN, J MAY 31, 2024 K/AK/ABK
